source_grounded_grammar: DH03 enters continuation only after a lower-timeframe counter-move weakens while parent directional structure remains intact.
Parent bundle for S06 is M15/M30 and parent policy is structural-priority.
Parent direction comes from DH01 confirmed structure plus signed efficiency/displacement, not one MA or one bar.
ParentImpulseExtreme is the most favorable causally known execution extreme established before pullback begins.
Pullback begins when fast signed movement becomes adverse to parent direction while parent remains intact.
CounterEfficiency_T = -d * SignedEfficiency_T; S06 threshold counter_eff is frozen at 0.6468 and pullback-start TF is S15.

EXHAUSTION_CANDIDATE requires weakening counterflow; source specifically records declining S15/S30 CounterEfficiency versus immediately prior completed observations plus no-new-adverse-extreme confirmations.
S06 exhaustion_decline is frozen at 0.4533 and no_new_extreme_count is 1.
LOCAL_RECLAIM uses a causally known S15 pivot for S06.
REACCELERATION uses completed S5 and requires parent-direction SignedEfficiency plus parent-direction NetMove after reclaim; reaccel_eff_min frozen 0.2854.
ENTRY_ELIGIBLE sequence is exhaustion -> reclaim -> reacceleration while parent remains valid.
Structural invalidation buffer is frozen at 0.3242 ATR_M5; max pullback age frozen at 513.6575 seconds.
All bars are left-closed/right-open and only completed/confirmed data may be used.

Prefer a source-grounded profile only if it materially approaches the preserved 1563/690/economic fingerprint across activity and winners, not merely one scalar net row.
